versions.content: Size Exceed With development error detection IdsMDevEr- rorDetect enabled, the IdsM module shall check the parameter contextDataSize of the function IdsM_ReportSecurityEvent, and shall report the development er- ror IDSM_E_PARAM_LENGTH when the value of the parameter exceeds the maximum configured context data buffer size. The maximum context data buffer size results from the largest configured IdsMContextDataBufferSize.
